landing.heroLine: Stage, image, and voice — between Mexico and Europe.
landing.bio:
Born in France to a Spanish father and a French mother, Sophie Gaëlle Gomez moved to Mexico at 24, where she worked as a model before dedicating herself fully to her acting career in theatre, film and television.

She has appeared in series streaming on international platforms, still running today, before turning to art-house cinema.

These experiences have shaped her sense of presence, narrative and image, as well as her approach to non-verbal communication and public speaking.

Since 2020, when not on set or at a shoot, she mentors those who wish to strengthen their presence, communicate more effectively and define their personal storytelling.

Now based back in Europe, she continues her research into presence and reinvents herself through Silver Presence — a project dedicated to expression, the body and authenticity, designed for women over 50.

actrice.title: Actress
actrice.bio:
Sophie Gaëlle Gomez is known for her intense screen presence and a performance style that explores subtle emotion, the gaze and silence.

After early work in television — El Señor de los Cielos, Rosario Tijeras, Monarca, still streaming on Netflix, HBO Max and ViX — she moved into art-house cinema, playing Tania in Aire, directed by Leticia Tonos: the official Dominican Republic submission for the Oscars and the Goya Awards 2025, and nominated for Best European Actress at the Septimius Awards.

Theatre-trained and now based in Europe after a long career in Mexico and Latin America, she is drawn above all to complex, nuanced characters of power.

modelo.title: Model
modelo.bio:
Sophie Gaëlle Gomez embodies a mature and elegant presence.

Aligned with the rising silver movement, she now lends her image to an aesthetic that embraces age and style with confidence.

She seeks collaborations with premium brands whose values and standards she shares.

silverPresence.title: Silver Presence
silverPresence.bio:
For years, I have studied presence. On stage, it is self-evident. In life, it slips away.

Silver Presence is an invitation to find again the woman who is becoming you — and to inhabit her fully, with calm, with precision, with grace — so that your presence speaks before your words do.
